limits: All spans and synchronous metrics are inclusive and can overlap; root.live contains currentSnapshots, sameOwner contains canonical work and canonical.digest contains canonical.bytes.
snapshot.clone measures LocalStore cloneSnapshot/copyValue, not structuredClone(state) in state-provider.ts:256; the unmeasured residual remains unknown.
sqlite.select.snapshot covers four snapshot query sites, not authentication or blob SELECTs. sqlite.begin measures synchronous exec only, not queue or lock-retry awaits.
SELECT and materialization-plan observations are recorded after return; finally-wrapped observations also count exits by exception. Metric count does not imply success.
diagnosticMs measures bookkeeping and prior emissions, not complete externally measured probe overhead; syncClockReads is recorded separately.
Numeric records have no authority data, references, stack traces or payloads; no per-call emission, sampling timer or cap is present.
Abort counts are prefixes, not successful-path totals or a controlled comparison with older profiles.

omni.reason: The focused run had no declaring test, made no Omni spawn and delegated none; it proves nothing about Omni.

failure.signature: error: calculation-ancestry-composition exceeded its 105000ms cooperative deadline
failure.phase: produce-outer: its publish.issue completed, then the subsequent explicit issue was interrupted
failure.test: C17 composition reopens a calculation with ledger ancestry and rejects a persisted cycle and revoked authority

interpretation: There are 24 records because this execution completed the first outer publish.issue and reached a second mixed prepare/produce pair. No emission cap was applied.
The full first mixed producer entered and accepted one physical root with 102 record joins. Its 43.562 seconds are a complete producer span, not the entire test.
Measured root.live and sameOwner durations do not explain the large complete-producer cost; their combined duration is an upper bound below 0.6% of that span.
canonical.digest includes canonical.bytes; currentSnapshots includes snapshot materialization. These inclusive groups must not be added together as exclusive CPU time.
The full owned producer opened one SQLite connection and made three snapshot SELECTs; the large SQL costs elsewhere belong to earlier unrooted phases in this run.

The final outer read count of 1374/1374 and the second mixed-producer span are aborted prefixes. Their difference from earlier runs is not evidence of an optimization, since product code is unchanged.
29,190,800 probe clock reads are disclosed. Measured bookkeeping is not a complete external measurement of observer overhead.
No result cache, authority reuse, replay deduplication or permission for a new product delta follows from these measurements.
Uninstrumented state-provider clones, other queries and the remaining wall-time residual remain unknown.
